caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition with a large cross at the top, which is outlined in red and filled with a light brown or tan color with blue and yellow accents. Below the cross, there is an arrangement resembling a bow with four loops, colored in matching tan, red, and blue with a yellow circle at the center of the bow. On each side of the bow, there is a wing-like shape, also in tan with red highlights at the tips. Beneath the bow, there is a large circular medallion outlined in red, with a repetitive geometric pattern inside consisting of a blue scalloped ring, radiating tan and red shapes resembling petals or sunrays, and a central yellow ring with a blue dot at its center. The entire composition is rendered on a cream-colored background. At the bottom, there is text that reads: "DOORWAY DESIGN - Santa Barbara Mission INDEX OF AMERICAN DESIGN."
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
